termination_rule.source: SIMPLER episode limits are not stated in arXiv 2503.24278v2 (we found none on 2026-11-22, and none again on 2026-11-23 in the first 100,000 of 106,503 characters of the HTML)

subject.note: SIMPLER WidowX scenes as used for the AutoEval paper's Table 3; the drawer scenes were built by the AutoEval authors. The AutoEval README points to the fork youliangtan/SimplerEnv (HEAD 583e4ce, 2025-09-16); that this fork produced Table 3 is [unverified]. Fold cloth has no SIMPLER side and is excluded

referent.producer: The AutoEval paper's authors. Two of its five authors are also SIMPLER authors, and the paper argues for real evaluation over SIMPLER

grader.by: human evaluators: Table 2 is the 'Ground truth human evaluation results for the five Bridge-AutoEval tasks across six different generalist policies' (2503.24278v2 App. C, caption, fetched 2026-11-23); App. C says nothing more on who scored or how
grader.rule: drawer completely closed, or opened at least 1.5 cm; eggplant fully inside the sink or basket at the end of the episode (2503.24278v2 §5.1, fetched 2026-11-23)

termination_rule.source: 2503.24278v2 App. C ('For both tasks on the Drawer scene, we evaluate all policies for 70 steps at maximum; for both tasks on the Sink scene, we run 100 steps'), fetched 2026-11-23. App. C reports Tables 1 and 2 together; that these limits also applied to the human-run evaluation is [unverified]

referent.real_repeat: arXiv 2503.24278v2 Table 1, AutoEval automated real evaluation of the same cells; independence from Table 2 unresolved (16 of 24 cells identical; dispersion test p = 0.14)

verdict_rules.cell: DISAGREE if the Newcombe interval at Bonferroni over 24 cells excludes 0; else FLOOR if both sides are at most 2 or at least 48 of 50; else AGREE if the 95% interval lies inside the tolerance; else INCONCLUSIVE

sensitivity: S1: AutoEval real table as the real reference
S3: unadjusted 95% for cells and pairs
fixed_note: after the input tables were read
